candidate_comparison.candidate_a: R92 base-conductance rule; replayed, not generalized
candidate_comparison.candidate_b: active evaluated conductances at the returned state
candidate_comparison.candidate_c: per-residual evaluated heat-flow ULP/operation terms; empirical project acceptance rule, not a formal IEEE-754 theorem

resource_cap_requalification.selection_criterion: smallest tested cap with all direct-seed fixtures accepted, at least two observed nfev of headroom, and cap >= ceil(1.5*observed worst nfev)
